system.description:
As a requirement to activate this jutsu, you must currently be in the Frog Fist Stance.

You enter a leaping stance prepared to support your team. When an allied creature within range would declare to you they are going make a melee attack against a creature within 30 feet of them, you stomp the ground knocking them into the air as you leap and jut your feet out, launching them towards their target at high speeds. The allied creature is moved up to 30 feet in a straight line towards their targets, ending in a space adjacent to them of their choice, where they then must make their melee attack. When they do, they can use either your Taijutsu attack bonus or their normal attack bonus. Regardless, on a success, they deal additional damage equal to your [Unarmed damage].

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage bonus by +1 [Unarmed damage die].
